gen-gf-goldman-work-sans: Work Sans keeps its curves open and its stroke level throughout. Goldman, with its wide, commanding capitals, gives way to a body that would carry paragraph after paragraph without tiring the eye.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-supreme: Hand-drawn Love Ya Like A Sister has ascenders that barely clear the x-height and no flicker of thick and thin. Supreme follows with a crisp, heavier-looking band of text, letters held open, so the page feels loose up top and firm below.
gen-nixie-one-fs-chillax: Nixie One draws thin, open curves with a retro-tech hum. Chillax loosens things below it, its relaxed letters trailing like spaghetti, so the stiff heading and the easygoing text keep each other in check.
gen-nixie-one-fs-plein: Nixie One has a nostalgic, retro-tech look, with open curves and a single constant stroke from top to baseline. Plein, meanwhile, is the reliable one, giving every round letter a clear channel in and keeping the text crisp where the heading is all character.
gen-nixie-one-fs-roundo: Roundo reads geometric and unfussy, with every small counter kept clear and each n built with arch and stem matching. And Nixie One is the one with personality, its open retro-tech curves doing the showing off while the body simply gets on with the words.
gen-nixie-one-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a dependable stripe of constant ink, with generous openings in every curve. Nixie One does the nostalgic, retro-tech flourish up top, while Synonym is the one built to carry the sentences without fuss.
gen-nixie-one-sora: Sora reads precise and geometric, its curves turning corners without any pressure swell. Nixie One's retro-tech heading sits over that tidy text, and the open curves in both make the two feel like relatives from different decades.
gen-nixie-one-space-grotesk: Retro-tech with room to breathe: the open curves of Nixie One hold a single constant stroke from top to baseline. Space Grotesk does the quieter work, its geometric, ribbon-like glyphs keeping the text steady.
gen-orbitron-fs-nunito: Orbitron spaces its letters far apart, each e with a large, clear eye. Nunito's big round bowls and soft terminals would make a long read feel approachable, a gentle landing after that precise, minimal heading.
gen-orbitron-fs-quicksand: Orbitron stretches its letters wide along the line, every e wearing a large, clear eye. Quicksand's strongest quality is its glassy roundness, tall bowls and bars of identical thickness, which softens that precision without dulling it.
